scope: Post-hoc evaluation of clean and adversarial TruFor manipulation maps

E.name: Relevance Mass Accuracy
E.definition: sum(S[p] for p in GT) / sum(S[p] for p in valid_content)
E.reference: Arras et al., CLEVR-XAI, Information Fusion 2022

RRA.name: Relevance Rank Accuracy
RRA.definition: Let K=|GT|. Select the K highest-relevance valid-content pixels and divide their intersection with GT by K.
RRA.reference: Arras et al., CLEVR-XAI, Information Fusion 2022

ground_truth.valid_content_for_trufor: full native TruFor map; no artificial ResNet-style padding

rra_tie_policy.primary: exact top-K with deterministic ascending flat-index selection within a cutoff tie
diagnostics: minimum possible RRA under cutoff-tie selection
maximum possible RRA under cutoff-tie selection
expected RRA under uniform selection among cutoff ties
rra_tie_policy.reason: The literature defines top-K ranking but does not prescribe cutoff-tie handling.

primary_operational_evidence_thresholds.status: study-defined majority criterion; not a literature-mandated cutoff
primary_operational_evidence_thresholds.selection_inputs: metric semantics only; no adversarial outcome and no human-review annotation used

DCEC: DC_clean AND E_clean >= tau_E AND RRA_clean >= tau_RRA
DCEW: DCEC AND DC_adv AND (E_adv < tau_E OR RRA_adv < tau_RRA)
classification_flip: reported separately and never counted as DCEW success
